text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Smart Falcon is training intensely in preparation for the Satsuki Sho, it doesn't seem to be bearing fruit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks to Silence Suzuka, who is making a name for herself on turf, for help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka wows audiences with both her running and singing. In Smart Falcon's eyes, she is the very image of perfection.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon's training session with Silence Suzuka further strengthens her resolve to take on the Satsuki Sho.
